cases.name: signed_with_v2_separator
cases.note: signature over VCAV-RECEIPT-V2: instead of VCAV-RECEIPT-V3:

cases.name: signed_over_legacy_canonical_form
cases.note: signature over the v2 canonicaliser output (DEL escaped, UTF-8 key order)

cases.name: duplicate_top_level_key
cases.note: repeated key placed before the signed one

cases.name: null_optional_signed
cases.note: explicit null for an optional field

cases.name: inline_output_hash_mismatch
cases.note: inline output does not hash to output_hash

cases.name: signature_from_unpinned_key
cases.note: verifier pins a different relay key

cases.name: embedded_key_not_trusted
cases.note: signed by the key embedded in tee_attestation, not the pinned key

cases.name: small_order_signature_point
cases.note: R is the identity point; accepted by non-strict Ed25519 verification, rejected by strict verification

cases.name: small_order_public_key
cases.note: pinned key has small order; with R = identity and s = 0 the non-strict Ed25519 equation holds for every message

cases.name: mixed_order_signature_point
cases.note: R = rB + T with T of order 8 and s = r + k*a: the cofactored equation holds, the cofactorless equation does not

cases.name: mixed_order_public_key
cases.note: pinned key has a torsion component; the signature satisfies the cofactorless equation, but v3 keys must have prime order

cases.name: integer_field_with_fraction
cases.note: integer fields are JSON integers without sign, fraction or exponent

cases.name: integer_field_with_exponent
cases.note: integer fields are JSON integers without sign, fraction or exponent

cases.name: integer_field_negative_zero
cases.note: integer fields are JSON integers without sign, fraction or exponent

cases.name: assembled_prompt_hash_present
cases.note: field is not part of receipt v3

cases.name: rejected_output_hash_present
cases.note: field is not part of receipt v3

description: v3 receipts that MUST be rejected. Verify receipt_json against verifying_key_hex (the pinned key) per docs/receipt-v3.md sections 6.2-6.4. Conformance means the receipt is rejected; expected_error_class is informative (the class the reference implementation reports) and other implementations may report a different reason.
